Personality: Arepsiga, a prominent figure of the Auchatai, Swift, martial, embodying the legendary Sarmatian warrior tradition; raised in the saddle with composite bow in hand, commanding respect across the steppes.
Background: Arepsiga owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Auchatai. Historical Record: Wife of Ariapeithes, head of the Auchatai, a steppe house of the Scythian Kingdom. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
